## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit has `Signed-off-by` (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` pass
- [ ] I wrote this myself or it comes from a source I may share (CLEANROOM.md)
- [ ] The provenance table in CLEANROOM.md and the CHANGELOG are updated where behaviour changed
